summary: Give 'em Hell, Harry! is a biographical play and 1975 film written by playwright Samuel Gallu. Both works are one-man shows about former U.S. President Harry S. Truman. The film stars James Whitmore and was directed by Steve Binder and Peter H. Hunt.
one_line: A biographical play and 1975 film by Samuel Gallu, presenting a one-man portrait of former U.S. President Harry S. Truman.
key_facts: Give 'em Hell, Harry! is a biographical play and a 1975 film.
Give 'em Hell, Harry! was written by playwright Samuel Gallu.
Both the play and the film are one-man shows about former President of the United States Harry S. Truman.
Give 'em Hell, Harry! stars James Whitmore.
Give 'em Hell, Harry! was directed by Steve Binder and Peter H. Hunt.
The work is titled "Give 'em Hell, Harry!"
Harry S. Truman served as President of the United States.
